text:
A finite lifetime gives each level a natural energy width of order

\[
\Gamma_i \sim \frac{\hbar}{\tau_i}.
\]

Thus,

\[
\Gamma_1 \sim \frac{6.58\times10^{-16}\ \text{eV·s}}{10^{-9}\ \text{s}}
=6.58\times10^{-7}\ \text{eV},
\]

\[
\Gamma_2 \sim \frac{6.58\times10^{-16}\ \text{eV·s}}{10^{-8}\ \text{s}}
=6.58\times10^{-8}\ \text{eV}.
\]

For clear resolution, the level separation should exceed the sum of the two widths (each counted once):

\[
|E_1-E_2| \gtrsim \Gamma_1+\Gamma_2
\approx 7.24\times10^{-7}\ \text{eV}.
\]

Among the choices, only \(10^{-4}\,\text{eV}\) is sufficiently large.

Answer: B
